lines: Ae mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: O love, I wept at how you ended.

lines: Ae mohabbat tere anjaam pe rona aaya

lines: Jaane kyun aaj tere naam pe rona aaya
couplets.en: I wonder why your name brought me to tears today.

lines: Yun to har shaam ummeedon mein guzar jaati thi
couplets.en: Every other evening passed in hope.

lines: Aaj kuchh baat hai jo shaam pe rona aaya
